messages:
lia: Quick copy check — after the canary rollback we show:

lia: "Rollout failed — partial traffic rolled back."

lia: My questions: primary CTA should be 'Retry rollout' or 'Rollback now'? Also do we need a short helper line clarifying whether user data or in-flight requests are affected?

sam: I'd avoid 'Rollback now' — sounds too destructive. 'Revert to previous version' is clearer. +emoji :thumbsup:

jess: Agreed on clarity. Suggest primary CTA: `Revert to previous version (v12)` and secondary: `View rollout details`.

morgan: 'Revert' could be misread as undoing config changes. What about 'Switch back to v12 (stable)' — language is explicit and less scary.

lia: Good point. Also we should include a one-line reassure: 'No writes are lost; only routing changed.' But that's heavy. Maybe "Traffic is switched back; no persisted data is lost." — shorter.

sam: Maybe: "Traffic switched to previous model. No persisted data lost." — concise.

jess: Also accessibility nit: make sure modal close button has aria-label 'Close rollback dialog' and CTAs have descriptive labels for screen readers.

lia: UX ask: add a small inline note under the title, smaller text: 'Canary reached 30% before error' — helps context.

deploy-bot: RolloutMonitor: canary rollback detected for deployment `reco-v2` — auto-note. (bot)

morgan: Final candidate strings:
- Title: "Canary rollback detected"
- Body line: "Canary reached 30% traffic and encountered errors. Traffic will be switched back to the last stable model."
- Primary CTA: "Switch back to v12 (stable)"
- Secondary CTA: "View rollout details"
- Helper: "No persisted data is lost by switching traffic."

lia: Love it. I'll patch this into the modal copy and drop a tiny a11y checklist for the engineers. Thanks y'all :raised_hands:

sam: Nice. small nit — use sentence case for helper: 'No persisted data is lost.'

jess: Approve from design side. :white_check_mark:

morgan: Approved. :thumbsup:
